name: Krillion 🦐 [UNLIMITED]
desc:
Krillion - The Deep Dive 🦐

Think you're good at thinking outside the box?
Answer questions and try to come up with the rarest answers possible. The more unique your answers are, the better your chances of winning!

- 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Create a party and play with friends (VC supported)
- 🌎 Join public lobbies and compete against other players
- 🔒 Create private games with your own party code
🏆 Be "One In A Krillion"
Every question is a chance to outsmart your opponents. Avoid the obvious answers, think differently, and see if you can come out on top!
🔥 Can you find the rarest answers?

llm.loop: answer open-ended prompts -> score by how rare your answer is vs other players -> win rounds in lobbies
llm.objectives: give the rarest answers and win the lobby
llm.instructions: create a party or join public lobby, answer prompts with unique answers
unique: trivia-like game that rewards uncommon answers (Family-Feud inverse); pixel-art deep sea style
llm.thumbnails: pixel krill logo, 'Name a country' prompt UI with rarer answers sink deeper, reacting avatars
llm.complexity_notes: prompt/answer similarity scoring backend, lobbies, UI polish, content writing
